subject: design/routing-evidence-v1
statement: The repository configuration names one dedicated evidence ref that every production reader fetches explicitly. The ref contains only immutable `routing-evidence/v1` event files at deterministic identity-derived paths; no append-hot aggregate is authoritative. The implementation may shard paths by identity prefix without changing logical identity.
